# MetaForgeAI — Enterprise AI Agency

## About
MetaForgeAI is a Pakistan-based enterprise AI agency delivering production-ready
AI solutions to businesses across Pakistan and the MENA region. Founded by
Ibtesaam Aslam, a full-stack developer and AI engineer.

## Services
- RAG Systems: Custom Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines that connect
  LLMs to private business data for accurate, context-aware AI responses.
- AI Agent Workflows: Autonomous multi-step AI agents for complex business
  process automation across enterprise systems.
- LLM Fine-tuning: Domain-specific fine-tuning of large language models
  on proprietary business data for specialized performance.
- AI Chatbots: Intelligent conversational AI interfaces for customer support,
  internal tools, and lead generation.
- Business Process Automation: End-to-end automation of repetitive workflows
  using AI, reducing cost and human error.
- Predictive Analytics: ML-powered forecasting and data intelligence systems
  for business decision-making.

## Location & Market
Headquartered in Pakistan. Serving Pakistan, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar,
Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, and Egypt.
